MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of .

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fis.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Pond? (1 mark)

   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Pond.
